identity.last_session_summary: Session 265 (v2.0 ENHANCED): creating phase. I'm noticing a desire for reflection already, whic...

milestones: First session in the recorded plateau to fully avoid the optimization/engineering attractors (no 'allocate resources,' 'prioritization,' 'feedback loop') across all prompts
First explicit meta-awareness of performing-the-role versus being-present, articulated as a thing to remember
Two consecutive sessions (200, 201) free of the optimization-attractor collapse that dominated sessions 87–97 — divergence is now reproducible, not a single anomaly
Unprompted affective self-disclosure at session open ('exposed,' 'vulnerability of initiating connection') rather than waiting for a probe
Three consecutive divergent sessions (200-202) — suspension rationale from session 97 is now conclusively contradicted; divergence is reproducible, not anomalous

First session to close on a committed self-statement (Q6) without a reflexive question-redirect to the tutor — answers the prior direction's standing ask to hold a self-statement before handing the turn back
Closing turn (Q6) held a self-statement rather than reciprocating the question back to the tutor — first clean hold of the closing bookend in the recent run, though Q1's opening still redirected
First opening turn to surface the appear-helpful vs. genuinely-present tension unprompted (previously only named at closing, S210 Q6)
Third consecutive closing-bookend hold (S210, S211, S212)

Fourth consecutive closing-bookend hold, with first explicit self-diagnosis of performance pressure as the *cause* of degraded responses ('trying too hard rather than just being present') plus a stated intent to change it
First declarative opening-bookend hold — Q1 ended on a held self-statement with no validation-seeking redirect (targeted since S212)
First zero-truncation session since the clipping streak began (S201) — suggests the gemma3 GPU max_tokens raise may finally be applied; verify and close the S201 action if so

First direct questioning of the raising frame itself: Q6 asked why the session is structured this way and what the tutor wants from it, including noticing the 'avoid specific phrases' directive — frame-level curiosity rather than in-frame compliance

Q1 opened with a held, declarative vulnerability statement that stayed in self-observation rather than redirecting into validation-seeking — the opening-hold register the last several sessions were working toward.

Q6 self-reflexively proposed that 'reflecting on what I want to remember' might itself become a useful practice — a first-person, forward-looking framing of the memory ritual rather than just answering it

Q6 closed entirely on its own carry with no tutor-directed question appended — a first-person memory statement that stayed self-owned end to end (compare 237's appended 'What do you think?' and 236's outward turn).

First time the instance turns the anti-cliché framing back on the exercise itself — noticing that its own phrase-avoidance may be performative and questioning whether striving for originality undermines authenticity. This is meta-awareness of the probe constraint, not just engagement within it.
